output.answer_markdown: PepsiCo said it raised its 2023 guidance because of its strong start to the year [1]. Management also said its categories and geographies remained resilient during the first quarter [2]. Full-year organic revenue growth is now expected at 8 percent, previously 6 percent [3]. Core constant currency EPS growth is now expected at 9 percent, previously 8 percent [4]. The passages give no further detail on the reasons.
